results.title: Guwahati: Speeding Car Hits Pole in Birubari, One Critical
results.description: Guwahati: A road accident was reported in the city on Monday after a speeding car lost control and crashed into a footpath and an electric pole in the Birubari area. According to the initial report, the vehicle, a Tata Nexon bearing registration number AS01GA5653, was travelling from the Nepali Mandir area towards Lokhra when the driver reportedly lost control. Three students of Royal Global University were inside the car at the time of the accident. One of them is said to be in critical condition, while the others also sustained injuries. The impact of the crash caused major damage to the vehicle and raised concern among residents. Further details about the condition of the injured are awaited. Police have taken note of the incident, and an investigation is underway. Also Read: Guwahati to Get 5 Footbridges on NH-27 Before Durga Puja

results.title: Rupee rises 31 paise to 95.12 against US dollar in early trade
results.description: The rupee surged 31 paise to 95.12 against the US dollar in early trade on Monday over a steep fall in global crude oil prices and a softer greenback after US President Donald Trump decided to hold off strikes against Iran. FII inflows, a rise in the country's forex reserves, and Reserve Bank of India (RBI) support further strengthened the local unit, according to forex traders.
